title: Decision: Launching Video Meeting Assistant Bot Product
goals: create new revenue stream, differentiate meeting offerings, improve user productivity, and capitalize on AI meeting assistant market opportunity

options.title: Full-Featured Meeting Copilot
options.description: Develop comprehensive AI assistant that handles real-time transcription, action item tracking, meeting summarization, and participant engagement analytics with custom LLM

options.title: Basic Meeting Notes Bot
options.description: Build simple bot focused on transcription and basic summarization using existing APIs, with potential to add features based on customer demand

options.title: White-Label Partnership
options.description: Partner with existing meeting assistant provider to offer their technology under our brand, with custom integration into our platform

options.title: Meeting Analytics Focus
options.description: Create specialized bot focused on meeting analytics, participation metrics, and engagement scoring, leaving basic transcription to third-party tools

criteria.title: Development Timeline
criteria.description: Expected time to market and resource requirements for each approach

criteria.title: Technical Complexity
criteria.description: Difficulty of implementation, including AI/ML requirements and platform integration challenges

criteria.title: Market Differentiation
criteria.description: Uniqueness compared to existing solutions from Zoom, Microsoft, and other competitors

criteria.title: Privacy & Security
criteria.description: Ability to maintain data privacy, security standards, and compliance requirements

criteria.title: Revenue Potential
criteria.description: Expected revenue based on market demand and pricing strategy

criteria.title: Operating Costs
criteria.description: Ongoing costs including AI processing, transcription services, and infrastructure

criteria.title: Platform Compatibility
criteria.description: Ability to work across different video conferencing platforms (Zoom, Teams, Meet)

criteria.title: Scalability
criteria.description: Capacity to handle growing number of concurrent meetings and users

criteria.title: User Experience
criteria.description: Ease of use, setup process, and integration with existing workflows
